video.script: Most teachers I know spend Sundays grading. But what if you didn't have to? Rubric AI takes your rubric and a student response, and in seconds gives you a suggested score for each criterion, a draft comment you can edit in ten seconds flat, and the one insight that would actually move their grade next time. Paste your rubric once. Grade thirty essays in thirty minutes instead of thirty hours. Free, runs in your browser. Link in the description.
